identities_derived_independently.method: structure constants C^c_ab = eps_abd n^dc (class A, orthonormal frame) -> Koszul connection (metric-compatible and torsion-free asserted) -> D_b sigma^b_a and 3-Ricci

I1_momentum_constraint.result: mock momentum_A(n,S) = -D_b sigma^b_a to 8.9e-16 over 50 random (n,S)
I1_momentum_constraint.meaning: AGREES UP TO AN OVERALL SIGN fixed only by orientation/sign conventions of the structure constants and of K_ab; the kernel/rank statements are sign-independent. The mock must declare its convention before any signed quantity (the sign of M and hence of beta_NM) is compared with literature.

I2_ricci_spectra.result: mock ricci_A eigenvalues equal the connection-derived ones exactly for types I, II, VI0/VII0-like, VIII-like, IX (1,1,1) and IX (2,1,1); antisymmetric part 0

identities_derived_independently.frame_closure: beta_RM=beta_NM, beta_MO=-beta_NM, beta_RO=0 holds only for collinear inverse boosts; not re-derived here

bounded_sweep_posterior_width.definition: noise-free data at lambda=1 (tilt amplitude); posterior sd of lambda and of |beta_NM| over the lambda grid; synthetic count/Gaia response scales 1.25/0.8 kept as declared mock constants

nuisance_projection.meaning: a single unbounded nuisance aligned with the label direction removes all label information (rank 1 -> 0)

interpretation: Posterior sd of the tilt amplitude grows roughly with the noise scale and saturates toward the prior width (sd_lambda 0.049 at 0.5x noise, 0.21 at 4x).

Because beta_NM saturates as M/w grows (beta = 2r/(1+sqrt(1+4r^2))), the enthalpy scale w changes the observable beta amplitude 0.42 -> 0.032 over a 16x range, i.e. w is a first-order nuisance for converting momentum to velocity.

Stronger kinematic correlation (mix 0.9) *reduces* the posterior sd here because the mock's mean channels are strongly aligned; this is a property of the chosen correlation structure, not a general statement.

The curvature oracle separates the selected II/IX pair only because its noise is declared idealised (sigma^2 = 0.375): at 2x sigma the MAP accuracy falls to 0.75 and at 4x to 0.63. Nothing here is a physical curvature measurement.
